# Life Ledger · Deep Review 3.5.1

Life Ledger 3.5.1 delivers the final polish across focus timer states, week board composition, journal day layouts, and hairline drawings, backed by a 62-row executable control verification suite.

## Focus state machine & completion
- Unified state model (`idle` → `running` → `paused` → `running` … → `completed` | `cancelled`) shared by toolbar chip, focus panel, and mini-player.
- Natural completion and Finish button display `focus-complete.svg` with minute echo detail and an Undo action in the toast that removes the just-recorded session and returns to idle.
- Skip/cancel during a live session clears timer state without confirmation dialogs.
- Keyboard support: Space toggles start/pause while panel has focus; Escape closes panel and returns focus to the toolbar chip.

## Week board & Journal day page
- Week view: selected day is primary, composed as a two-column day sheet at ≥1180px (habits with check controls on the left; reflection excerpt, photo presence, and focus minutes on the right), collapsing to one column below 1180px.
- Day rail has a spacious minimum width (no cramped dates) and features a completion meter per day.
- Weekly goals section sits directly under the day sheet with compact margins, eliminating dead whitespace at 1440px.
- Journal day page: single composed sheet layout with date/mood/status header row, reflection text directly below, photo memories grid with inline count ("Photos · X of 3") and Add tile as first grid slot, and compact two-column habit check-off list.
- Empty photo tiles feature a faint dashed frame outline that fills when a memory is attached.

## Today header & accessibility
- Today header integrates an 80px hairline illustration box with the greeting and date in a unified 3-column grid (`80px minmax(0, 1fr) auto`).
- Secondary text raised to 12px and `--secondaryLabel` darkened to #575953 on light (and #b7b9b2 on dark).

## Hairline illustration set
- Extended 160×120 hairline SVG set: added `focus-paused.svg`, `focus-cancelled.svg`, `empty-week-goals.svg`, and `journal-no-reflection.svg`.
- Updated `focus-complete.svg` with minute echo detail.
- Full compliance with hairline grammar and App Shell precaching.

## Verification & quality gates
- Automated Playwright verification in `scripts/evidence/controls.mjs` executing all 62 rows from the audit matrix.
- Multi-viewport (980, 1180, 1440, 1600) and multi-locale (`en`, `de`, `zh`) screenshot matrix in `scripts/evidence/screens.mjs` verifying zero horizontal scroll and zero errors.
- Side-by-side visual comparison contact sheets in `scripts/evidence/before-after.mjs`.
- Interaction video sequence in `scripts/evidence/video.mjs`.
- GitHub Actions CI workflow in `.github/workflows/evidence-351.yml`.
